question: Which of the following classical dancers won the Padma Shri award in 2022 for the dance form of Kuchipudi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gaddam Padmaja Reddy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Gaddam Padmaja Reddy 

 
 
• Gaddam Padmaja Reddy, a well-known Kuchipudi dancer, received the Padma Shri award in 2022 for her tireless efforts to advance the dance style.
 
• Former President Ram Nath Kovind presented the Padma Shri to Padmaja Reddy.
 
• She is from Pamarru, a village located about 15 kilometers away from Kuchipudi.
 
• For nearly 50 years, she has been performing Kuchipudi.
 
• She is renowned for bringing to life on stage the illustrious past and beauty of the Kakatiya empire.
 
• The 51-year-old Hyderabadi dancer has performed in more than 3000 concerts across 100 nations.
 
• She was also influenced by the book Nritta Ratnavali, which describes classical and traditional dance.
 
• At the age of five, she started dancing.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Birju Maharaj:** 

 
 
• **Birju Maharaj**, whose full name was **Brijmohan Mishra**, was a renowned **Indian dancer and a master of the Kathak** form.
 
• He was a significant exponent of the **Kalka-Bindadin gharana** (community of musicians sharing a distinctive musical style) of Lucknow 1.
 
• He was **born** on **February 4, 1938**, and **died on January 16, 2022**, in New Delhi, India 1.
 
 
 
• **Hema Malini:**
 
 
• Hema Malini is a **veteran of Bollywood** and a celebrated **Indian film actress**. She is also known as a **skilled classical dancer**.
 
• She launched her acting career in the **1960s**, and over her extensive career, she starred in over **150 films**, with notable roles in both commercial and art house cinema.
 
• In addition to her acting and dancing careers, Malini has been involved in politics. She is a** member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** and has served as a Member of Parliament.
 
 
 
• **Sujata Mohapatra:**
 
 
• Sujata Mohapatra is a renowned **Indian classical dancer** and **choreographer** specializing in the **Odissi style** of dance.
 
• She was initially trained by** her father-in-law**, the **great Odissi Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra**. After his passing, she has carried on his legacy and continues to be a leading exponent of the art form.
 
• **Mohapatra** has received numerous awards for her dance performances, and she has performed at several prestigious festivals and dance events both within India and internationally.
